recent: 近期公告主要是大股东 Dato' Sri Law Kiu Kiong 与 Law Kiong Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 连续多日申报持股变动，另有季度与月度生产数据披露。
notable: 大股东 Dato' Sri Law Kiu Kiong 与 Law Kiong Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。

risks: 大股东在约一个月内多次申报持股变动，具体增减方向需查阅公告内文。

recent_en: Recent announcements mainly comprise repeated substantial shareholder interest changes by Dato' Sri Law Kiu Kiong and Law Kiong Holdings Sdn. Bhd., along with quarterly and monthly production disclosures.
notable_en: Substantial shareholder Dato' Sri Law Kiu Kiong and Law Kiong Holdings Sdn. Bhd. filed multiple changes in interest between October and November.
The company disclosed quarterly production figures and monthly production figures.
risks_en: The substantial shareholder filed multiple interest changes within about a month; the direction of increase or decrease requires checking the announcement details.
